steps.name: Close Splash Island for today
steps.do: Open **Create attraction closure override**. Choose **Splash Island**, leave dates blank or covering **today**, and enter a **Closure message** (e.g. **Manual test Splash Island closed**), then submit.
steps.expect: Success that the **Splash Island** closure override was saved.

steps.name: Open builder for today
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Itinerary**. Use **Build Itinerary** / **Edit Itinerary**, and on **Set Visit Date** choose **today**.
steps.expect: Visit date is set to today.

steps.name: Open attractions without include
steps.do: Continue to **Add Attractions**. Leave **Include closed attractions** unchecked and search for **Splash Island**.
steps.expect: **Splash Island** is absent from results while the include toggle is off.

steps.name: Include closed attractions
steps.do: Enable **Include closed attractions**, then select **Splash Island**.
steps.expect: **Attraction May Be Closed** appears with message **The Splash Island is closed on your visit date. Do you still want to add it to your itinerary?**

steps.name: Cancel confirm
steps.expect: **Splash Island** is not added to the selection.

steps.name: Confirm add
steps.expect: **Splash Island** is added to the attraction selection.

steps.name: Finish with closed attraction
steps.expect: The itinerary saves with **Splash Island** on the plan.
